# Taste Skill design guidance reference

Motion UI's compact guidance is an original adaptation of general ideas from
https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill: content-driven composition, hierarchy,
substantive simplicity, useful interactions and honest visual review.

Reviewed 2026-10-14: skills/taste-skill/SKILL.md and gpt/soft/minimalist variants.
No upstream scripts or skill text, randomized website workflow, mandatory imagery,
marketing structure or fixed aesthetic bans are bundled or executed. Motion UI
retains its own style selection, sandbox contracts and conversation delivery.
